chain.title: What separates fMRIPrep's output from larmorx's

links.cause: correctly rounded maths instead of glibc's

chain.note: Each box holds runs that give the same bytes. Atropos' result does not depend on ANTs' thread count, and fMRIPrep's own run is the repository's ANTs result; larmorx differs from it only where glibc's maths is not correctly rounded, in the last bits of a few posteriors. Its default mode then corrects ITK-50 (the metrics below), a change smaller than ANTs' own spread when it seeds from the clock.

tables.title: Partial-volume classes with the MRF on the phantom of known fractions: Dice per class and the share of voxels labelled as the truth (the record's cases)
tables.note: Classes 1-3 are the tissues, 4 and 5 the partial-volume classes 1x2 and 2x3. ANTS-106: in ANTs' MRF a partial-volume label is +1 against every neighbour, its own tissues included; corrected, it is a member of its own set (−1 with its tissues, −2 with itself, +1 with any other label). larmorx's default also corrects ITK-50 and ANTS-96 (the k-means split points, the partial-volume means), which alone change the MRF-0 row. ANTs stops when a class wins no voxel.
